review_notes: I read the whole file. I searched Mathlib for existing versions of its declarations: `Path.prepend`, `Path.reparamHomotopy`, `Path.continuous_reparam`, continuous maps between path spaces (`C(Path ..., Path ...)`), and any other `reparam` continuity or homotopy lemmas. I found only `Path.reparam` (Topology/Path.lean) and `Path.Homotopy.reparam` (Topology/Homotopy/Path.lean). The file builds on both and does not redefine them. It adds a continuity statement in the path variable, a homotopy of maps between path spaces, and a bundled prepend map plus homotopy equivalence. I found no existing Mathlib counterpart for any of these. I also grepped the rest of TauCeti for `prepend` and `reparam`. The only related declaration is the Moore-path `prependHomotopyEquiv`, which the docstring says is a deliberately different model. I found no competing concept to consolidate.
